scope: 64 distinct fresh HTTP pages per runtime; native empty absolute generated boxes, blockification, actual owner/ancestor containing blocks, percentage insets, border/padding, negative offsets, normal-flow exclusion, scroll overflow and mutations; supplemental fixture, not original WPT
limitations: Only empty generated strings are supported; non-empty text, images and counters remain unsupported
